interpretation.timeline: Original full save at3900/tick1710 to5340/tick2070: canonical360 windows from344+16, two cold segments,361 physical calls with345 replay. Suffix alone5276 to5340:16 new ordinary windows/64 game minutes.
interpretation.hungerDirection: Saved needs.hunger is fullness: larger values mean less hungry; thresholds below20/30/48 are explicitly observational categories.
interpretation.cash: Resident wallets exclude player, treasury, company/shop operating funds, bank and tax custody. Cash increases/decreases are measured endpoint deltas, not proof of injections or their absence.
interpretation.employment: District rates are original saved commerce output, not new exact endpoint isEmployed evaluations. Capacity/role/assigned shift/working state/earned minutes are not interchangeable.
interpretation.food: Shop inventories and personal carried food only; excludes freight custody, ingredients, dishes and separate company stores. Consignment lots are ownership records already included in shop inventory and are not counted twice.
interpretation.foodAffordability: Any stocked open food offer with price <=wallet; distance, permissions, routes and arrival NOT_OBSERVED.
interpretation.companyCapital: Capital is an operating account; company/shop inventory are separate fields. Company capitalization cannot be added to bound shop funds as additional cash.
interpretation.limits: No native calls/imports, game code execution, new tests, performance measurements, money/food correction, long-term sustainability or all-domain pass claim.
